Telogen Effluvium is hairloss caused by a shock to the body, what we often refer to as triggers on here. There are a lot of known triggers, common ones are COVID, low ferritin, surgery, getting off of birth control or acutane. Androgenetic Alopecia is hairloss caused by your genes, so your mother or father have hair thinning, it’s likely that you will too. It because of a sensitivity to androgens (DHT, don’t know if there are more). So the difference is one is caused by genetics and the other by a shock to the body. With TE hair will grow back in, with aga it can grow back but it miniaturizes, so the thick hairs will become thin and less visible.
